sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.market_ticker, lo.limit_price as px, lo.quantity as qty from live_orders lo where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and lo.created_at >= '2026-10-18 03:00'), m as (select o.market_ticker, min(c.spread) as spread, max(o.px) as px, sum(o.qty) as qty from o left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=o.id group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from m) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select case when spread is null then 'z ?' when spread<=1 then 'a 1c' else 'b 2c+' end as spread, count(*) as settled_mkts, sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int) as losers, round(sum(case when p.realized_pnl<0 then -qty*px/100.0 else qty*(100-px)/100.0 end)::numeric,2) as usd from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 group by 1 order by 1
